name: Sauk County, WI
findings: Sauk County has 250 nonprofit organizations. 118 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 102 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sauk County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
